seo_title: Bank API Integration: Automate Your Reconciliation
seo_desc: Wasting hours checking transfers? We integrate Open Banking APIs to automatically reconcile invoices in your small business's ERP.
author_pitch: As a Cloud Specialist, it frustrates me to see freelancers and small business owners wasting their Friday mornings logging into the bank app to manually check off which client has paid and which invoice is still pending. It is administrative work that adds no value. I design cloud API integrations that connect your bank directly to your invoicing program, detecting incoming transfers and marking invoices as paid in real time, so you can focus on selling.
title: The bank statement slavery: Cloud API Integration to automate your reconciliation
body:
Are you wasting your Friday morning logging into your bank app to check incoming transfers one by one and manually cross-reference them with your issued invoices?

For a freelancer or a small agency, charging by bank transfer is the cheapest and safest way to operate, but it generates a hidden administrative bottleneck. Every week, you have to download the bank statement, open your billing program, and start looking for matches by amount or concept. This manual process steals hours of productive work, causes you to mistakenly claim payments from clients who had already paid, and prevents you from knowing how much liquid money you really have until you reconcile at the end of the month.

The trap of Manual Downloads (Standard 43)

Many small business owners try to speed this up by downloading text files (Standard 43) from the bank to upload them manually into their ERP, facing formatting errors and duplicate lines. Acting as a human bridge by downloading files between your bank and your accounting software is the symptom of broken digitization.

Our solution: Cloud Open Banking API Integration

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we put your treasury on autopilot. As Cloud specialists, we use the European PSD2 standard to integrate a secure API that communicates your bank's server directly with your billing software (like Holded, QuickBooks, or your custom system).

  1. Real-Time Bank Connection: The API silently and securely monitors your business account (read-only), detecting any incoming payment the exact second the bank processes it.
  2. Smart Data Matching: The cloud algorithm analyzes the sender, the amount, and the concept of the transfer to automatically search for the corresponding invoice in your database.
  3. Automatic Reconciliation and Closing: Upon finding the match, the system marks the invoice as "Paid" in your management program, generating the accounting entry without you touching a single button.
  4. Unidentified Payment Alerts: If a client pays the wrong amount or forgets to include the invoice number, the Cloud gateway sends you an alert via Slack or email so you can review it with a single click.

The Real Impact on your Daily Treasury

  • Goodbye to Administrative Work: You recover up to ten hours a month previously lost checking statements, freeing up your schedule to get more clients or rest.
  • Up-to-the-Minute Financial Control: Your billing dashboard always shows the true status of your collections and debts, allowing you to make investment decisions with total confidence.
  • Improved Client Relationships: You eliminate the embarrassment of sending payment reminders to clients who had already made the transfer the day before.
